## Studded Lizard (CR 5)

A blue-black, forked tongue flicks out of this stocky lizard’s mouth as it sniffs out its next meal.  

**XP** 1,600  
N Small animal  
**Init** +6; **Senses** low-light vision, scent, tremorsense 60 ft.; Perception +16  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+2 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)  
**hp** 77 (7d8+21)  
**Fort** +8, **Ref** +4, **Will** +8  
**Defensive Abilities** Dr 5/bludgeoning or piercing  


**Offense**


**Speed** 20 ft.  
**Melee** bite +10 (1d6+7 plus 5 bleed [anticoagulant saliva] plus poison)  
**Space** 5 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  


**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 14, **Con** 17, **Int** 2, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 6  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +9 (includes -1 size modifier); **CMD** 21 (includes -1 size modifier)  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor, Skill Focus (Perception), Skill Focus (Stealth)  
**Skills** Climb +14, Perception +16, Stealth +19, Swim +9; Size Modifier +4 Stealth  
Languages—  
**Sq** anticoagulant saliva, mimic, slowing venom  


**Special Abilities**


**Anticoagulant Saliva (Ex)** When a studded lizard makes a successful bite attack against a creature, the creature takes 5 points of bleed damage.  

**Mimic (Ex)** A studded lizard changes the pigmentation and patterns on its skin to exactly mimic other non-venomous lizards native to the desert. The DC to identify the studded lizard is 5 higher than normal to see past this ruse and correctly identify it. On a failed skill check, the studded lizard is incorrectly identified as a native, nonthreatening lizard that feeds on insects.  

**Poison (Ex)** Bite—injury; save Fort DC 15; onset immediate; frequency 1 round; effect 1d4 Constitution damage and 1d2 Dexterity damage. The save DC is Constitution-based.  

**Slowing Venom (Ex)** A creature’s speed is decreased by 5 feet for every point of Dexterity damage that it takes from the studded lizard’s poison. Slowing Venom can’t reduce a creature’s speed to less than 5 feet. A creature’s speed is restored if the poison is neutralized or when the Dexterity damage is healed, whichever comes first.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** desert  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** none
